core_obligations: Reductions (proof lines 5299-5306): case (1) => (2) by 07RL; case (2) => (4) by the definition 01VW of quasi-projective.
Ample case (proof lines 5307-5310): 01ZY produces the affine open through v_1, ..., v_d, verifying the criterion for (3).

Relative cases (proof lines 5312-5321): shrink Y affine (X affine follows); in (4) X-ample means ample on the affine base (01VH), reducing to (3); in (5) shrink V to a quasi-compact open containing the points and restrict the very ample sheaf, which is ample there (01VN), reducing to (4).
proof_roadmap: Reduce (1) and (2) to (4), and (3) directly via 01ZY (proof lines 5302-5310).
Reduce (4) and (5) to (3) after shrinking to affines (proof lines 5312-5321).
